screen.choose_status: Choose the printer's Print Status sensor in the inspector
screen.choose_keys: Choose the printer's buttons and light in the tile's inspector for keys
screen.stop_confirm: Tap stop again to stop the print
screen.not_sent: Not sent: may the screen perform actions?

app.name: Creality 3D printer
app.summary: How your Creality printer's print goes, its temperatures, and keys to pause, resume and stop.
app.nozzle_hint: The printer's temperature sensors (Nozzle Temperature, Bed Temperature, Chamber Temperature). Leave out what it lacks or you do not want: the K1 SE, Ender 3 V3 and Hi have no chamber sensor.
app.layer_hint: The Working Layer and Total Layers sensors, for "Layer 126 of 300".
app.light_hint: The printer's light, for a key on the control card. The K1 SE and Ender 3 V3 have none.
app.buttons_hint: The integration's Pause Print, Resume Print and Stop Print buttons, for the keys of the control card.
